user_story: As a user, I want the login endpoint to return an error when the email field is empty so that I provide all required credentials.

positive.title: Successful login with valid credentials
steps: Send a POST request to the login endpoint with valid email and password.
Verify the response status code is 200.
positive.expected_result: User successfully logs in and receives a token.

negative.title: Error when email field is empty
steps: Send a POST request to the login endpoint with an empty email field and a valid password.
Verify the response status code is 400.
negative.expected_result: The response contains an error message indicating that the email field is required.

negative.title: Error when both email and password fields are empty
steps: Send a POST request to the login endpoint with both email and password fields empty.
Verify the response status code is 400.
negative.expected_result: The response contains an error message indicating that both email and password fields are required.

negative.title: Error when email is invalid
steps: Send a POST request to the login endpoint with an invalid email format and a valid password.
Verify the response status code is 400.
negative.expected_result: The response contains an error message indicating that the email format is invalid.

edge.title: Error when email is a valid format but not registered
steps: Send a POST request to the login endpoint with an email that is in valid format but not registered and a valid password.
Verify the response status code is 401.
edge.expected_result: The response contains an error message indicating that the email is not registered.
